_about: Signature file for the CVE matcher: curated product/version -> CVE mappings for the lab targets. This is the matcher's reference data, kept separate from the matching logic in cve_matcher.py and from data/answer_key.json (the independent evaluation ground truth). 'product' and 'version' must match what the Nmap parser writes onto Finding.product and Finding.version. Each entry uses either an exact 'version' or a 'version_min' / 'version_max' range. Confirm any value marked TBC against a real scan.
